title: Order status page stuck in pending
description_long: Use this when the demo portal shows an order as pending even after the background job completed.
steps: Clear the mock cache, rerun the status sync, and verify the order state updates.
extracted_text: cache rerun status sync order state

title: Invoice sync retry for stale token
description_long: Use this when the invoice connector reports an expired or rejected token in the demo environment.
steps: Generate a fresh demo token, restart the connector, and replay the failed invoice batch.
